products.name: Merchant Payment Processing Solutions
products.description: A digital platform providing merchants with integrated payment processing services, including debit card, credit card, and ACH payments, via proprietary gateway technology and secure tokenized vaults. Delivered through cloud-based infrastructure and integrated with popular e-commerce platforms, it is designed for regulated and high-risk industries.

products.name: Point-of-Sale Consumer Financing (Buy Now, Pay Later)
products.description: A proprietary digital platform offering point-of-sale financing solutions, including installment loans, zero-interest 'Pay-in-4' products, and lease options, to consumers at retail stores and online merchants. The platform covers the full credit spectrum and is delivered via integrated APIs and e-commerce plugins.

products.name: Fundraising and Payments Platform for Political Campaigns and Nonprofits
products.description: A digital platform providing integrated payment processing, fundraising, donor data management, and analytics tools for political campaigns, committees, and nonprofit organizations. The platform supports multiple payment methods, including cards, digital wallets, and cryptocurrency, and emphasizes compliance, data privacy, and operational continuity.

products.name: Alzheimer’s Disease Therapeutics (Pipeline)
products.description: A portfolio of investigational drug candidates, including IGC-AD1 (in Phase 2 trials), TGR-63, LMP, IGC-M3, and IGC-1C, targeting various symptoms and disease-modifying mechanisms of Alzheimer’s disease. These are developed through pharmaceutical R&D, clinical trials, and require regulatory approval.

products.name: Metabolic Disorder Therapeutics (Pipeline)
products.description: Preclinical drug candidates such as IGC-1A and IGC-1C targeting metabolic disorders (e.g., type 2 diabetes, obesity) using mechanisms like GLP-1 and GIP receptor agonism. These are developed via pharmaceutical R&D and require clinical trials and regulatory approval.

products.name: Artificial Intelligence (AI)-Powered Alzheimer’s Diagnostic Tools
products.description: AI and machine learning models, such as the Multimodal Interpretable Transformer for Alzheimer’s Disease (MINT-AD), developed to support clinicians in early detection, risk stratification, and cognitive decline prediction for Alzheimer’s. Delivered as digital tools for clinical decision support.

products.name: Over-the-Counter (OTC) Wellness and Lifestyle Products
products.description: Branded wellness and lifestyle products, including hemp-based formulations, manufactured in company facilities and sold through retail and online channels. These products are compliant with applicable laws and do not require prescription or FDA approval.

products.name: YARTEMLEA (narsoplimab-wuug)
products.description: A proprietary, FDA-approved human monoclonal antibody that selectively inhibits MASP-2 in the lectin pathway of complement, manufactured via biologics processes and distributed as a sterile injectable for the treatment of hematopoietic stem cell transplant-associated thrombotic microangiopathy (TA-TMA).

products.name: MASP-2 Inhibitor Therapeutics (including OMS1029 and small-molecule inhibitors)
products.description: A pipeline of antibody and small-molecule therapeutics targeting MASP-2 in the lectin pathway, developed for chronic and acute complement-mediated diseases; includes long-acting biologics (OMS1029) and orally administered small molecules, produced via biologics and chemical synthesis for clinical and potential commercial use.

products.name: MASP-3 Inhibitor Therapeutics (including Zaltenibart and small-molecule inhibitors)
products.description: Therapeutics targeting MASP-3 in the alternative complement pathway, including the partnered monoclonal antibody zaltenibart (OMS906) and retained small-molecule MASP-3 inhibitors for various immune and complement-driven disorders; manufactured as biologics or small molecules for clinical and potential commercial use.

products.name: PDE7 Inhibitor Therapeutics (OMS527)
products.description: A portfolio of orally administered small-molecule PDE7 inhibitors developed for the treatment of addictive and compulsive disorders (such as cocaine use disorder) and movement disorders; produced via chemical synthesis for clinical trials and potential commercialization.

products.name: OncotoX-AML Oncology Therapeutics
products.description: A preclinical biologic therapeutic designed to selectively target and kill dividing cancer cells, specifically developed for acute myeloid leukemia (AML); produced as an engineered large molecule for future clinical trials and potential commercialization.

products.name: Targeted Complement Activating Therapy (T-CAT) Platform
products.description: A preclinical platform of recombinant antibody therapeutics designed to harness complement activation for direct killing of multidrug-resistant pathogens (bacteria, fungi, viruses, parasites); produced as recombinant biologics for infectious disease indications.

products.name: Skilled Trades Education Programs
products.description: Career-oriented postsecondary education programs in skilled trades such as electrical, HVAC, welding, CNC machining, and advanced manufacturing with robotics. Delivered through a combination of classroom instruction and hands-on laboratory exercises at physical campuses, often using simulated workplace environments.

products.name: Automotive Education Programs
products.description: Postsecondary education programs in automotive fields including automotive technology, collision repair, diesel and truck technology, and heavy equipment service. Programs are delivered via classroom and hands-on training at campus facilities, preparing students for entry-level technician and mechanic roles.

products.name: Health Sciences Education Programs
products.description: Career-oriented education programs in health sciences such as medical assisting, patient care technician, dental assistant, and licensed practical nursing. Delivered through classroom, laboratory, and required externship experiences at campus locations.

products.name: Information Technology Education Programs
products.description: Postsecondary education programs in information technology, such as computer systems support technician, delivered through classroom and hands-on instruction at campus facilities.

products.name: Utility Coal Mining Services
products.description: Operation and management of surface coal mines under exclusive, long-term contracts to supply coal as fuel for adjacent power plants and a synfuels plant. Delivery is typically via conveyor or short-haul rail, and services include mine operation, coal delivery, and mine reclamation, with some contracts based on management fees per ton delivered.

products.name: Contract Mining Services
products.description: Provision of contract mining and related services for producers of industrial minerals and products, including aggregates (limestone, sand, gravel) and lithium. Services include mining operations, dragline services, and comprehensive mining for third-party owned mines and quarries, delivered through long-term contracts.

products.name: Mineral and Royalty Interests Leasing
products.description: Acquisition, ownership, and leasing of oil, natural gas, and coal mineral and royalty interests to third-party exploration and production companies, generating income through royalty payments based on production revenues. The company holds various types of royalty and mineral interests across multiple U.S. basins.

products.name: Natural Resource Restoration and Mitigation Services
products.description: Provision of natural resource restoration and reclamation services, including stream and wetland mitigation solutions, and sale of mitigation credits. Services are delivered through projects that meet regulatory permit criteria, primarily in the southeastern U.S.

products.name: Energy Infrastructure Development (Renewable and Hybrid Power)
products.description: Development of new power generation resources, including solar arrays, solar-gas hybrid projects, thermal generation, and carbon capture, primarily on reclaimed mining properties. Projects are developed directly or through joint ventures and depend on federal tax incentives.

products.name: Surface Use Royalties and Revenues
products.description: Fees and royalties for the use of surface acreage for business operations such as oil and natural gas development, produced water transportation and handling, pipeline and electrical infrastructure, digital infrastructure, commercial fuel distribution, and other commercial and industrial activities. Delivered through long-term agreements, with customers constructing and operating infrastructure on LandBridge's land.

products.name: Produced Water Handling Royalties
products.description: Royalties and fees from produced water transportation, handling, recycling, and disposal infrastructure built and operated by customers (primarily WaterBridge and others) on LandBridge's land. LandBridge provides access to surface acreage and pore space, while customers bear capital and operating costs.

products.name: Brackish Water Sales and Royalties
products.description: Sales of brackish water extracted from LandBridge's land for use in oil and natural gas well completions, and royalties from brackish water produced by customers. Water is delivered via infrastructure built and operated by customers or affiliates.

products.name: Sand and Caliche Resource Sales and Royalties
products.description: Royalties and fees from sand and caliche extracted from LandBridge's land, primarily for use in oil and natural gas well completions and infrastructure construction. Customers construct and operate sand mines and extract caliche at their expense, paying LandBridge per ton or cubic yard.

products.name: Oil and Gas Royalties
products.description: Royalties from oil, natural gas, and NGL production on LandBridge's mineral interests, leased to E&P companies. LandBridge receives a percentage of proceeds from production, with minimal operational involvement.

products.name: Non-Hazardous Oilfield Reclamation and Solid Waste Facility Royalties
products.description: Royalties and fees from non-hazardous oilfield reclamation and solid waste disposal facilities constructed and operated by customers (primarily WaterBridge) on LandBridge's land. LandBridge provides land access and receives a percentage of gross revenue from these operations.

products.name: Easements and Surface-Related Revenues
products.description: Fees from granting easements, rights-of-way, and surface use agreements for infrastructure such as roads, pipelines, and electric transmission lines. Customers pay fixed or recurring fees for access and use of LandBridge's land for these purposes.

products.name: Renewable Energy Project Surface Use (Solar, Power Storage, Microgrids)
products.description: Surface use fees and payments from leasing land for renewable energy projects such as solar power generation, power storage, and microgrids. LandBridge does not own or operate these projects but provides land access under long-term agreements.

products.name: Digital Infrastructure Surface Use (Data Centers, Cryptocurrency Mining)
products.description: Surface use fees and payments from leasing land for digital infrastructure projects such as data centers and cryptocurrency mining facilities. LandBridge provides land access but does not own or operate these facilities.

products.name: Commercial Fuel Distribution Facility Surface Use
products.description: Fees from leasing land for commercial fuel distribution facilities constructed and operated by third parties. LandBridge provides land access and receives surface use payments.

products.name: Rare Disease Therapeutics (including Cortrophin Gel, ILUVIEN, YUTIQ)
products.description: Development, manufacturing, and commercialization of specialty pharmaceuticals for rare diseases, including Cortrophin Gel (an ACTH injection for autoimmune and inflammatory disorders) and retina franchise products ILUVIEN and YUTIQ (intravitreal implants for eye diseases). These products are produced via complex pharmaceutical manufacturing and are distributed through specialty pharmacies and direct sales to healthcare providers.

products.name: Branded Pharmaceuticals
products.description: Portfolio of branded pharmaceutical products acquired or licensed, including Atacand, Arimidex, Casodex, Inderal LA/XL, InnoPran XL, Lithobid, Oxistat, Vancocin, Veregen, and others. These are manufactured either in-house or via contract manufacturers and marketed through a dedicated sales force and partnerships.

products.name: Generic Pharmaceuticals
products.description: Development, manufacturing, and commercialization of a broad portfolio of over 120 generic pharmaceutical products across various indications, including oral solids, semi-solids, liquids, topicals, controlled substances, and potent products. Products are produced at company-owned manufacturing facilities and through third-party manufacturers, and distributed via wholesalers, pharmacies, and healthcare providers.

products.name: Unapproved Pharmaceutical Products
products.description: Marketing of certain pharmaceutical products without approved NDAs or ANDAs, including Esterified Estrogen with Methyltestosterone, Opium Tincture, Thyroid Tablets, and Hyoscyamine. These are manufactured and distributed under FDA's risk-based enforcement policy.

products.name: Hydraulic Fracturing Services
products.description: Provision of hydraulic fracturing services for oil and gas well completions, utilizing a fleet of mobile high-pressure pumps, dual-fuel and electric-powered equipment, and supporting logistics and personnel. Services are tailored to customer needs and delivered on-site in the Permian Basin.

products.name: Wireline Services
products.description: Provision of wireline and ancillary services for new oil well completions, including perforating and pumpdown operations, using a fleet of mobile wireline units and pressure control equipment operated by specialized crews.

products.name: Cementing Services
products.description: Provision of cementing services for well completions and remedial work, using pressure pumping equipment to deliver cement slurry for well integrity and zonal isolation, with a dedicated fleet of cementing units.

products.name: Power Generation Services
products.description: Turnkey power generation services for oil and gas producers, industrial projects, and data centers, delivered via mobile natural gas-fueled generators, turbines, and battery storage equipment installed at customer sites, with pricing based on power generated or contracted capacity.

products.name: Wet Sand Solutions for Hydraulic Fracturing
products.description: Provision of wet sand solutions for hydraulic fracturing at well sites, including onsite storage and handling of sand used as proppant in the completion phase of shale wellbores, enabled by a dedicated fleet of trucks and equipment.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a range of loans to businesses, including term loans, lines of credit, working capital loans, business expansion loans, equipment and machinery loans, land development loans, interim construction loans, and owner-occupied and non-owner occupied commercial real estate loans. These are delivered through in-person banking centers and require significant financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Residential Real Estate Lending
products.description: Offers loans secured by 1-4 family residential properties, including home equity loans and construction loans. These loans are originated through physical branches and digital channels, requiring underwriting, regulatory compliance, and capital.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Provides a full range of deposit products to consumers and businesses, including certificates of deposit, interest checking accounts, money market accounts, and savings accounts. These are delivered through physical branches and digital banking platforms, requiring regulated infrastructure and deposit insurance.

products.name: Digital Banking Solutions
products.description: Offers digital banking services, including online and mobile banking platforms, enabling customers to access accounts, transfer funds, and manage finances electronically. These services are delivered digitally and require technology infrastructure and cybersecurity measures.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provides loans to individual consumers for purposes such as automobile purchases, consumer durables, and personal needs, including debit and credit card products. These are delivered through branches and digital channels, requiring underwriting and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Trust and Wealth Management Services
products.description: Offers trust administration, estate planning, and wealth management services to individuals and businesses, managing assets and providing fiduciary services. These services are delivered through specialized staff and require regulatory oversight and expertise.

products.name: Retail Brokerage Services
products.description: Provides retail brokerage services, enabling customers to invest in securities and other financial instruments. These services are delivered through licensed representatives and digital platforms, requiring regulatory compliance.

products.name: Treasury Management Services
products.description: Offers treasury management solutions to business clients, including cash management, payment processing, and related financial services. These are delivered through specialized teams and digital platforms, requiring technology and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Agricultural Lending
products.description: Provides loans to agricultural businesses and individuals for farming and ranching operations, including land, equipment, and operational financing. Delivered through branches with specialized lending staff, requiring regulatory compliance and risk management.

products.name: Virtual Primary Care Services
products.description: Subscription-based virtual medical care delivered via proprietary telehealth platform, including synchronous and asynchronous consultations, diagnosis, treatment, and ongoing care management by an affiliated provider network. Services are accessed through desktop and mobile applications and may be reimbursed by insurance or paid in cash.

products.name: Weight Management Programs
products.description: Medically supervised weight loss programs delivered virtually, including access to GLP-1 and non-GLP-1 medications, metabolic coaching, lab work, and prescription services. Includes insurance navigation and partnerships for branded medications, with ongoing patient monitoring and support.

products.name: Men’s Health Services
products.description: Virtual diagnosis, treatment, and prescription fulfillment for men’s health conditions such as erectile dysfunction, premature ejaculation, hair loss, insomnia, weight loss, and performance anxiety, delivered via the Rex MD telehealth platform and supported by affiliated licensed providers.

products.name: Testosterone Replacement Therapy (TRT)
products.description: Comprehensive, subscription-based virtual care program for low testosterone, including clinical evaluation, lab testing, diagnosis, ongoing hormone monitoring, dosage management, and prescription fulfillment, integrated with the Rex MD platform.

products.name: Women’s Health Services
products.description: Virtual care platform focused on perimenopause, menopause, bone health, and hormone optimization, offering continuous, coordinated care with specialized providers, in-home and remote diagnostics, medications (generic and compounded), supplements, and lifestyle support.

products.name: Behavioral Health Services
products.description: Teletherapy, psychiatry, and medication management for common mental health conditions, delivered virtually through the affiliated provider network and integrated into the longitudinal care framework.

products.name: Hair Loss Treatment Products and Services
products.description: Virtual medical treatment for male and female hair loss, including prescription medications, patented doctor-formulated OTC products, topical compounded medications, and FDA-approved medical devices, delivered via the ShapiroMD telehealth platform.

products.name: Pharmacy Services and Prescription Fulfillment
products.description: Integrated pharmacy services including prescription dispensing, advanced non-sterile compounding for oral and topical medications, and fulfillment through a wholly-owned commercial pharmacy and partner pharmacies, supporting LifeMD’s telehealth brands and external customers.

products.name: B2B Telehealth Partnerships and Platform Services
products.description: Provision of telehealth technology platform and virtual care expertise to healthcare product companies, enabling digital patient awareness, access to care, adherence, compliance, and integrated prescription fulfillment for partner brands and pharmaceutical manufacturers.

products.name: CM-101 Monoclonal Antibody Therapeutic
products.description: A first-in-class, fully humanized monoclonal antibody targeting the soluble protein CCL24, designed to block its activity and thereby attenuate both fibrosis and inflammation. CM-101 is produced using standard biologics manufacturing processes and is delivered via intravenous or subcutaneous administration. It is being developed for the treatment of multiple severe fibrotic and inflammatory diseases, with a primary focus on rare orphan indications such as primary sclerosing cholangitis (PSC) and systemic sclerosis (SSc), and potential future expansion into other fibro-inflammatory conditions like NASH and idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF).

products.name: AI Cloud Infrastructure Services
products.description: Provision of secure, scalable, GPU-accelerated computing infrastructure for AI model training and inference, delivered via managed Kubernetes or bare metal, with high-throughput storage and networking, operated in company-controlled data centers and available in multi-tenant or single-tenant configurations. Includes ongoing support, consulting, migration, and workload optimization services.

products.name: Confidential Computing Solutions for AI
products.description: Confidential computing services designed to protect customers’ intellectual property and enhance compliance, including the Corvex Secure Model Weights product, which enables secure AI model deployment on third-party GPU infrastructure using Trusted Execution Environments and advanced encryption.

products.name: Token Factory (AI Model Access Platform)
products.description: A developing platform expected to provide access to premium open-source AI models via API integration and a proprietary inference engine, operating on automatically scaling infrastructure to improve performance and reduce inference costs for customers.

products.name: Wellness Ring (Women's Health Wearable)
products.description: A wearable device designed for women, providing continuous health and wellness metrics such as heart rate, blood oxygen, sleep, activity, and menstrual tracking, delivered as a consumer product without FDA clearance, with data and insights accessible via digital interfaces.

products.name: Medical Ring (FDA-Cleared Health Monitoring Wearable)
products.description: A prescription-only wearable device with FDA 510(k) clearance for pulse oximetry and vital signs monitoring, intended for clinical trials, remote patient monitoring, and healthcare provider use, offering clinical-grade data and compliance with medical device regulations.

products.name: Next-Generation Health Monitoring Wearables (in development)
products.description: Development of advanced wearable devices incorporating proprietary System-on-a-Chip technology for continuous blood pressure and glucose monitoring, aiming for future FDA Class II clearance and targeting both consumer and clinical markets.

products.name: Commercial and Small Business Banking Services
products.description: A suite of banking products for small and medium-sized businesses, including commercial, industrial, and owner-occupied lending and leasing, SBA lending, municipal and public finance, depository and cash management, business credit cards, merchant processing, corporate trust, and correspondent/international banking. Delivered through physical branches and digital channels, requiring regulated infrastructure and financial capital.

products.name: Capital Markets and Investment Banking Services
products.description: Customized financing and advisory solutions for business clients, including loan syndication, private credit placement, risk management (interest rate, commodities, foreign exchange), securities underwriting, M&A advisory, strategic advisory, capital raising, and commercial mortgage-backed securities conduit lending. Delivered by specialized teams and subject to financial regulations.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Financing solutions secured by commercial real estate, including term loans and construction/land development loans for multifamily, industrial, retail, office, residential, community development, and affordable housing projects. Requires significant financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Retail Banking Services
products.description: A broad range of consumer banking products, including residential mortgage lending, home equity lines, personal loans, depository accounts, consumer credit cards, and personal trust services. Delivered through branches and digital platforms, requiring regulated infrastructure and financial capital.

products.name: Wealth Management Services
products.description: Personalized wealth management solutions, including investment management, fiduciary and estate planning, and advanced business succession planning. Delivered by specialized advisors and subject to financial and fiduciary regulations.

products.name: Feed Ingredients
products.description: Production and sale of non-food grade oils and protein meals, including meat and bone meal, poultry meal, feather meal, blood meal, and fats, primarily for use in animal feed, pet food, aquaculture, and as feedstock for biofuels. These are produced by collecting and processing animal by-products, bakery residuals, and used cooking oil at large-scale rendering and recycling facilities.

products.name: Bakery Residual Feed Ingredients
products.description: Collection and processing of bakery residuals from commercial bakeries into feed ingredients, such as Cookie Meal®, primarily used in poultry and swine rations. This involves automated bulk collection, sorting, drying, and grinding to produce animal feed additives.

products.name: Organic Fertilizers
products.description: Manufacture and sale of organic fertilizers using protein produced from animal by-products, approved by the USDA for organic farming. Production involves processing animal by-products into fertilizer products for use in agriculture, landscaping, and turf management.

products.name: Insect Protein and Oils
products.description: Production of specialty proteins and oils for animal feed and pet food by rearing and processing black soldier fly larvae. This is achieved through proprietary insect farming and processing technology.

products.name: Hides and Skins
products.description: Processing of cattle hides and hog skins into treated hides and skins for commercial applications, primarily for sale to tanneries and manufacturers in the leather, automotive, shoe, and furniture industries. This involves collection, treatment, and preservation of hides and skins.

products.name: Grease Trap Services
products.description: Provision of grease trap collection and disposal services to food service establishments, including regulatory compliance and waste transport. The collected trap grease is transported to waste treatment centers.

products.name: Collagen and Gelatin Ingredients
products.description: Production and sale of collagen and gelatin ingredients from animal bones, hides, pig skins, and fish skins for use in the food, nutraceutical, pharmaceutical, pet food, and technical industries. Manufacturing involves extraction, purification, and processing at specialized facilities worldwide.

products.name: Natural Casings
products.description: Production and sale of natural casings from porcine and bovine intestines for use in sausage manufacturing and other food products. This involves harvesting, sorting, and processing intestines at specialized facilities.

products.name: Crude Heparin
products.description: Extraction and processing of porcine mucosa into crude heparin for pharmaceutical applications. This is achieved through hydrolysis and purification processes at dedicated facilities.

products.name: Edible Fats
products.description: Refining and packaging of animal fats into food grade fats for use in the food industry. Production involves melting, refining, and packaging processes to meet food safety standards.

products.name: Bone Products
products.description: Processing of animal bones into bone protein, glue, bone ash, and bone chips for use in the feed, pet food, food, and collagen industries. This involves specialized extraction and processing operations.

products.name: Renewable Diesel and Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF)
products.description: Production and sale of renewable diesel and SAF from animal fats, used cooking oils, and other feedstocks using advanced hydroprocessing and isomerization technology at large-scale joint venture facilities. Products are marketed to fuel distributors and obligated parties in low-carbon fuel markets.

products.name: Biogas and Bioenergy
products.description: Production of biogas and green power from organic sludge and food waste through industrial digestion operations, as well as processing manure into natural biophosphate for fertilizer and green gas. Operations are primarily in Europe and involve large-scale anaerobic digestion and refining.

products.name: Low-Grade Energy from Fallen Stock
products.description: Collection and processing of fallen stock and certain animal by-products into fats and meals used as low-grade energy sources for industrial applications, such as fuel for boilers and cement kilns. This is a regulated service in Europe involving specialized collection and rendering.

products.name: WAKIX (pitolisant)
products.description: A once-daily oral tablet for the treatment of excessive daytime sleepiness (EDS) and cataplexy in adult and pediatric patients with narcolepsy, manufactured via pharmaceutical synthesis and distributed through specialty pharmacies.

products.name: Next Generation Pitolisant Formulations (Pitolisant GR and Pitolisant HD)
products.description: Oral formulations of pitolisant, including gastro-resistant and high-dose versions, developed for improved dosing and expanded indications such as narcolepsy and idiopathic hypersomnia, produced via pharmaceutical manufacturing and in clinical development.

products.name: BP1.15205 (Orexin 2 Receptor Agonist)
products.description: A novel orexin 2 receptor agonist for the treatment of narcolepsy and other potential indications, currently in preclinical and early clinical development, with exclusive rights to develop, manufacture, and commercialize in the US and Latin America.

products.name: EPX-100 (clemizole hydrochloride)
products.description: A serotonin (5HT-2) receptor agonist developed as an oral therapy for rare epilepsies such as Dravet Syndrome and Lennox-Gastaut Syndrome, produced via pharmaceutical synthesis and currently in Phase 3 clinical trials.

products.name: EPX-200 (liquid formulation of lorcaserin)
products.description: A selective 5HT-2C agonist in liquid formulation for the treatment of developmental and epileptic encephalopathies, in pre-IND phase, developed for oral administration.

products.name: HBS-102 (MCHR1 antagonist)
products.description: A melanin-concentrating hormone receptor type 1 antagonist for potential treatment of hyperphagia, weight gain, and metabolic disorders, in preclinical development, produced via pharmaceutical synthesis.

products.name: Cell Replacement Therapies for Refractory Epilepsies and Treatment-Resistant Narcolepsy (CBS105 and CBS104)
products.description: Discovery-stage cell replacement therapies under research collaboration for refractory epilepsies and treatment-resistant narcolepsy, involving advanced biotechnological development and preclinical research.

products.name: Life Science Real Estate Leasing
products.description: Leasing of Class A/A+ laboratory and office properties, primarily located in collaborative Megacampus ecosystems within major life science innovation clusters. Properties are physically developed, owned, and operated by the company and leased to external tenants in the life science, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and related sectors.

products.name: Life Science Real Estate Development and Redevelopment Services
products.description: Development and redevelopment of new or existing properties into high-quality, generic, and reusable laboratory and office spaces for lease to external tenants. This includes ground-up construction and conversion of office, warehouse, or shell space into laboratory facilities, delivered as physical real estate assets.

products.name: Strategic Capital and Venture Investment Platform
products.description: Provision of strategic capital and venture investments to external life science companies, primarily through equity investments in publicly traded and privately held entities. These investments are financial in nature and support the growth of innovative life science businesses.

products.name: Residential Solar Energy Systems
products.description: Design, development, installation, sale, ownership, and maintenance of solar energy systems for residential homeowners, delivered through both direct sales and long-term service agreements. Systems are physically installed on customer homes and interconnected to the utility grid.

products.name: Residential Solar Energy Service Agreements (Leases and Power Purchase Agreements)
products.description: Provision of solar energy as a subscription service to residential customers via long-term leases or power purchase agreements, including system monitoring, maintenance, insurance, and performance guarantees. Customers typically pay no upfront costs and receive predictable pricing over 20-25 year terms.

products.name: Residential Battery Storage Solutions
products.description: Sale and integration of battery storage systems with residential solar installations, providing backup power, increased resiliency, and enhanced energy management capabilities. Delivered as an add-on to solar systems in select markets.

products.name: Solar and Storage Solutions for Multi-Family and New Homes
products.description: Provision of solar and battery storage systems to commercial developers for multi-family residences and new home construction, including design, installation, and ongoing service. Delivered through direct sales and partnerships.

products.name: Energy Services for Utilities and Grid Management
products.description: Management of distributed residential energy resources to provide services that benefit utilities and the electric grid, such as demand response and grid support, leveraging the installed base of solar and storage systems.

products.name: Exchange-Traded Products (ETPs)
products.description: A broad suite of investment products including ETFs and other exchange-traded vehicles, covering equities, commodities, fixed income, leveraged-and-inverse, cryptocurrency, currency, and alternative strategies. These are physically or synthetically structured, listed on exchanges, and managed using proprietary or third-party indexes, with both passive and active management approaches.

products.name: Digital Asset Products and Services
products.description: Blockchain-enabled investment products and services, including tokenized real world assets, stablecoins, tokenized mutual funds (Digital Funds), and regulated digital funds accessible via institutional and consumer digital wallets. Delivered through proprietary platforms and compliant with evolving digital asset regulations.

products.name: Private Asset Investments (Farmland and Alternatives)
products.description: Investment products providing exposure to private assets, primarily U.S. farmland strategies, managed through open-ended funds and private placements. These require specialized asset management and are delivered via acquired alternative asset management capabilities.

products.name: Model Portfolios and Advisor Solutions
products.description: Technology-enabled, research-driven model portfolios and portfolio construction solutions for financial advisors, including CIO-managed models, portfolio consultations, and co-managed portfolios. Delivered via advisor platforms and marketplaces, integrating both proprietary and third-party products.

products.name: Hotel Franchising Services
products.description: Licensing of hotel brands and provision of franchise services to hotel owners, including access to brand standards, marketing, reservation systems, loyalty programs, and operational support. Delivered through franchise agreements for both new construction and conversion hotels across multiple chain scales and geographies.

products.name: Hotel Ownership and Operations
products.description: Direct ownership and operation of select hotels under company brands, generating revenue from guest stays. Involves physical real estate investment, hotel management, and provision of hospitality services at owned properties.

products.name: Hotel Management Services
products.description: Management of hotels on behalf of owners, providing operational oversight, staffing, and hospitality services in exchange for management fees and cost reimbursements. Delivered through management agreements, sometimes including payroll management for hotel employees.

products.name: Vendor and Partnership Programs
products.description: Partnerships with qualified vendors and travel partners to provide value-added products and services to franchisees and guests, including procurement solutions, travel-related services, and marketing collaborations. Revenue is generated from partnership services and fees.

products.name: Aerospace and Defense Forged Components
products.description: Manufacture and supply of forged and machined components, including envelope and precision forgings, for military and commercial aircraft, helicopters, vehicles, and munitions. Products are made from steel, high temperature alloys, nickel alloys, titanium, and aluminum, and delivered to OEMs, Tier 1/2 suppliers, and aftermarket service providers.

products.name: Commercial Aircraft Forged Components
products.description: Production and delivery of forged and machined components for commercial aircraft, including structural airframe parts, landing gear, wheels, and brakes, primarily for large aircraft produced by Boeing and Airbus as well as general aviation. Components are manufactured using advanced metals and delivered to OEMs and aftermarket providers.

products.name: Industrial Gas and Steam Turbine Components
products.description: Manufacture of forged and machined components for industrial gas and steam turbines, including turbine blades, for the energy sector. Products are made from high-performance alloys and supplied to OEMs and aftermarket customers in the energy industry.

products.name: Commercial Space Industry Components
products.description: Production of forged and machined components for commercial space applications, supporting launch vehicles and satellite constellations. Components are made from advanced materials and delivered to customers requiring high reliability and technical performance.

products.name: Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment Components
products.description: Manufacture of high-purity, technically demanding forged and machined components used in semiconductor manufacturing equipment. Products require stringent material and performance standards and are supplied to semiconductor industry customers.

products.name: Commercial and Industrial Forged Products
products.description: Production of forged and machined components for various commercial and industrial applications outside of aerospace, defense, energy, and space. Products are made from a range of metals and supplied to diverse industrial customers.

products.name: Heat-Treatment, Surface-Treatment, and Non-Destructive Testing Services
products.description: Provision of heat-treatment, surface-treatment, non-destructive testing, select machining, and sub-assembly services for forged components. These services are performed in-house and may be offered to external customers as value-added processing.

products.name: Confectionery Products
products.description: Manufactured and sold branded candy and confectionery items, including chocolates, caramels, lollipops, mints, bubble gum, and chewy candies, produced in company-owned plants and distributed to retail and wholesale customers through various channels.

products.name: Hydrogen Fuel Cell Systems
products.description: Electrochemical devices that combine hydrogen and oxygen to produce electricity and heat without combustion, manufactured and delivered for stationary and mobility applications, including material handling vehicles and stationary power generation. Delivered as integrated systems and supported by ongoing maintenance services.

products.name: Hydrogen Production Equipment and Solutions
products.description: Manufactured and installed equipment and systems for the production of hydrogen, including PEM electrolyzers and hydrogen production plants, enabling customers to generate hydrogen on-site or purchase produced hydrogen. Includes gigafactory-scale production and modular, scalable electrolyzer systems.

products.name: Hydrogen Liquefaction Systems
products.description: Engineered liquefaction systems that convert gaseous hydrogen into liquid form for efficient storage and transport, utilizing proprietary designs for operational efficiency and reliability. Manufactured and installed for industrial and commercial customers.

products.name: Cryogenic Hydrogen Equipment
products.description: Designed and manufactured cryogenic solutions for the storage, transport, and handling of liquid hydrogen and other cryogenic gases, including storage tanks, delivery trailers, vaporizers, and portable equipment. Delivered as physical products to customers requiring hydrogen logistics infrastructure.

products.name: Hydrogen Fueling and Dispensing Systems
products.description: Integrated systems for the delivery, storage, and dispensing of hydrogen fuel, including on-site fueling stations and infrastructure for material handling, mobility, and industrial applications. Includes GenFuel systems and related installations.

products.name: Liquid Hydrogen Supply and Delivery
products.description: Production and sale of liquid hydrogen as a fuel alternative, delivered from company-owned production facilities or through third-party supply arrangements to customers in material handling, mobility, and stationary power sectors.

products.name: Hydrogen Ecosystem Turn-Key Solutions
products.description: Vertically integrated, end-to-end solutions combining fuel cells, hydrogen fuel, fueling infrastructure, and maintenance services into a single offering (e.g., GenKey), simplifying customer transition to hydrogen-powered operations.

products.name: Maintenance and Service Programs for Hydrogen Systems
products.description: Ongoing maintenance, monitoring, and on-site service programs for installed hydrogen fuel cell systems, fueling infrastructure, and related equipment, delivered through IoT-based platforms and field service teams.

products.name: Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) Software
products.description: A suite of software products, including Windchill and Arena, that manage all aspects of the product development lifecycle, from concept through service and end-of-life, enabling real-time information sharing, collaboration, and regulatory compliance. Delivered as both on-premises and SaaS solutions.

products.name: Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) Software
products.description: Software solutions, such as Codebeamer and pure::variants, that accelerate the development of software-defined products, supporting the creation and management of multiple software variants throughout the product lifecycle. Delivered digitally as enterprise software.

products.name: Service Lifecycle Management (SLM) Software
products.description: ServiceMax and Servigistics software solutions that optimize asset uptime, manage service parts inventory, and improve technician productivity through mobile tools and analytics. Delivered as enterprise software to support in-person and remote service operations.

products.name: Computer-Aided Design (CAD) Software
products.description: Creo and Onshape platforms for digital product design, simulation, and modification, enabling collaborative workflows and real-time analytics. Delivered as both traditional and cloud-native SaaS solutions for 3D modeling and design.

products.name: Online Resale Marketplace for Apparel, Shoes, and Accessories
products.description: A managed online marketplace where buyers can browse and purchase secondhand apparel, shoes, and accessories, and sellers can send in items using Clean Out Bags for ThredUp to process, photograph, list, and sell. The platform is powered by proprietary logistics, software, and data science, and operates through ThredUp's website and mobile app.

products.name: Resale-as-a-Service (RaaS) for Brands and Retailers
products.description: A B2B service enabling brands and retailers to offer their own scalable closet clean out service and/or resale shop to their customers, leveraging ThredUp’s platform and logistics infrastructure.

products.name: Flavor Compounds and Taste Solutions
products.description: Development and production of flavor compounds and natural taste solutions, including value-added spices and seasonings, used in savory, beverage, sweet, and dairy products. These are manufactured through formulation and blending of natural and synthetic ingredients and delivered to food and beverage manufacturers.

products.name: Specialty Food Ingredients
products.description: Portfolio of natural, artificial, and plant-based specialty food ingredients, including proteins, emulsifiers, sweeteners, antioxidants, antimicrobials, and inclusion products, manufactured via chemical, enzymatic, and blending processes for use in food, beverage, and related products.

products.name: Enzymes, Cultures, and Probiotics
products.description: Biotechnology-derived enzymes, food cultures, and probiotic strains produced via fermentation and bioprocessing, used in food, beverage, animal nutrition, household, and industrial applications to enhance product performance, nutrition, and sustainability.

products.name: Fragrance Compounds and Ingredients
products.description: Creation and manufacture of fragrance compounds (fine and consumer fragrances) and fragrance ingredients (natural and synthetic), used in perfumes, personal care, fabric care, home care, and sold to third parties. Production involves blending, synthesis, and extraction processes.

products.name: Dietary Supplement and Functional Nutrition Ingredients
products.description: Ingredients for dietary supplements, functional foods and beverages, and specialized nutrition, produced through extraction, formulation, and bioprocessing, and supplied to manufacturers in the health and wellness sector.

products.name: Animal Nutrition Solutions
products.description: Feed enzymes and animal health solutions, including specialty ingredients to improve nutrition, welfare, and sustainability in livestock farming, produced via bioprocessing and supplied to animal feed manufacturers.

products.name: Biofuel and Grain Processing Ingredients
products.description: Yeasts and enzymes for biofuel production and carbohydrate processing, manufactured through fermentation and supplied to biofuel producers and grain processors.

products.name: Pharmaceutical Excipients (divested in 2025)
products.description: Cellulosics and seaweed-based pharmaceutical excipients for prescription and over-the-counter pharmaceuticals and dietary supplements, produced via extraction and chemical processing (business divested in May 2025).

products.name: Handcrafted Coffee and Espresso Beverages
products.description: A broad range of premium, customizable coffee and espresso-based drinks, including classics like Lattes, Americanos, Cappuccinos, and signature creations, produced in company-owned roasting facilities and served in-store, via drive-thru, or through digital ordering.

products.name: Proprietary Fuel Energy Drinks
products.description: A proprietary line of customizable iced and frozen energy drinks, available in Original and Sugar-Free varieties with a wide array of flavor combinations and add-ons, produced in-house and served in-store, via drive-thru, or through digital ordering.

products.name: All-Day Breakfast Food Items
products.description: A selection of savory and sweet breakfast-oriented food items, such as breakfast burritos, sandwiches, banana bread, and donut holes, prepared for quick service and available throughout the day in-store, via drive-thru, or through digital ordering.

products.name: Packaged Coffee Products (Beans, K-Cups, Cold Brew Bags)
products.description: Branded packaged coffee products, including custom blend roasted beans, K-Cup pods, and cold brew bags, produced in company-owned roasting facilities and sold for at-home consumption.

products.name: RECELL Autologous Cell Harvesting Devices
products.description: A portfolio of FDA-approved, single-use and reusable medical devices that enable clinicians to create a suspension of a patient’s own skin cells (Spray-On Skin™) at the point of care for the treatment of acute thermal burns, full-thickness skin defects, and other acute wounds. Devices are manufactured under cGMP and delivered directly to hospitals and burn centers.

products.name: PermeaDerm Biosynthetic Wound Matrix
products.description: A biosynthetic wound matrix manufactured and distributed exclusively by AVITA Medical in the U.S., designed to provide wound coverage and support healing for a variety of acute wounds. The product is physically manufactured, features transparency, variable porosity, and flexibility, and is delivered to hospitals and surgical centers.

products.name: Cohealyx Collagen-Based Dermal Matrix
products.description: A collagen-based dermal matrix branded as Cohealyx, developed and commercialized under exclusive agreement, designed to support wound bed preparation and accelerate readiness for grafting in full-thickness wounds. The product is manufactured using advanced bovine collagen and distributed to acute care hospitals and burn centers.

products.name: KARNO Power Modules
products.description: Modular, fuel-agnostic, linear generator-based power generation systems for stationary and mobile applications, manufactured using advanced additive manufacturing and delivered as standalone or multi-module units for distributed, backup, or prime power. Delivered as physical equipment with integrated controls, enclosure, and balance-of-plant systems, and can be deployed in various configurations (grid-following, grid-forming, islanded).

products.name: Research and Development (R&D) Services
products.description: Contract-based R&D services for third parties, primarily government and defense customers, involving design, testing, validation, and customization of power generation systems, including delivery of prototype units and technical reports. Delivered through engineering labor, testing, and technical deliverables.

products.name: Immune Modulation Therapeutics (ADI/Adimune Platform)
products.description: DNA-based immune modulation therapeutics designed to induce immune tolerance for organ transplant recipients and patients with autoimmune diseases. These are biologic drugs manufactured under GMP and delivered via injection, requiring regulatory approval and clinical trials.

products.name: Mitochondrial DNA-based Diagnostic Tests (Mitomic® Technology Platform)
products.description: Blood-based molecular diagnostic tests leveraging mitochondrial DNA mutations for early detection and risk assessment of cancers and other diseases. Developed and processed in a CLIA-certified laboratory using advanced molecular biology and automation.

products.name: Immune System Profiling and Monitoring (AditxtScore™ and FlowSpot)
products.description: Personalized immune profiling services and assays that measure immune responses to various agents (viruses, bacteria, drugs, transplants, cancer) using proprietary multiplexed platforms. Delivered as laboratory-developed tests with digital reporting, requiring specialized laboratory infrastructure.

products.name: DNA Adductomics Diagnostic Platform
products.description: Diagnostic kits and laboratory services for comprehensive detection and analysis of DNA adducts (early indicators of genomic instability and cancer risk) using proprietary mass-tag enhancements and advanced sample processing. Still in early development and validation stages.

products.name: Antiviral and Antimicrobial Therapeutics
products.description: Therapeutic drugs and solutions targeting life-threatening viral infections and emerging pathogens, developed for clinical and commercial use to address unmet needs in infectious disease and population health. Involves pharmaceutical R&D, regulatory approval, and manufacturing.

products.name: Women’s Health Therapeutics and Solutions
products.description: Innovative therapeutic products and solutions addressing critical unmet needs in women’s health, including potential products for endometriosis and other conditions. Involves pharmaceutical development, clinical validation, and regulatory approval.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides loans to small and mid-sized businesses, including commercial and industrial loans and commercial mortgages, primarily funded through local deposits and managed by relationship managers with credit expertise. Loan origination and servicing require in-person human labor and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Offers fixed-rate and adjustable-rate residential mortgage loans, including conforming and jumbo loans, to individuals, underwritten to government-sponsored enterprise guidelines and secured by real property. Loans are originated and serviced through a combination of digital and in-person channels, with some sold into the secondary market.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provides consumer loans including home equity lines of credit, home equity loans, direct consumer loans, and indirect automobile loans, often secured by personal property or unsecured, requiring credit evaluation and compliance with consumer protection laws.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offers a range of deposit products such as checking accounts, savings accounts, money market accounts, and certificates of deposit to individuals and businesses, managed through a network of physical branches and digital banking platforms. These deposits are insured and regulated.

products.name: Wealth Management Services
products.description: Provides wealth management services including trust and estate administration, investment management, pension and employee benefit plan administration, and related advisory services, delivered by specialized staff and supported by regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Insurance Products
products.description: Offers insurance products to customers through its financial services subsidiary, requiring licensing and compliance with state insurance regulations. Products are distributed via in-person and digital channels.

products.name: Brokerage Services
products.description: Provides brokerage services for securities and investment products to customers, delivered through licensed representatives and digital platforms, and regulated by the SEC and FINRA.

products.name: Mutual Funds and Annuities
products.description: Offers access to mutual funds and annuities as investment products to customers, distributed through its financial services subsidiary and requiring regulatory compliance.

products.name: Tax Preparation Services
products.description: Provides tax preparation services to customers through its financial services subsidiary, delivered by trained staff and supported by digital and in-person channels.

products.name: Interest Rate Swaps and Derivative Services
products.description: Offers interest rate swaps and related derivative financial instruments to commercial loan customers, enabling them to manage interest rate risk. These services require specialized financial expertise and are supported by regulated infrastructure.
